description: This Swift file defines a ViewModifier named StatusGlassCardModifier for styling SwiftUI views with a glass-like appearance, including padding, background with rounded rectangle, stroke border, and shadow. It also extends the View protocol with a convenience method statusGlassCard to apply this modifier.

classes.name: StatusGlassCardModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that adds a glass-like styled overlay with configurable padding and brightness effects.

methods.name: statusGlassCard
methods.description: A View extension method that applies the StatusGlassCardModifier with specified styling parameters.
